about: The secreta of the formulary “21st Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Graciously accept these sacrificial gifts, O Lord, with which You have willed us to find favor with You, and, by Your mighty love, restore salvation to us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
